fact: Bank Al-Maghrib pronounced 7 disciplinary and 8 financial sanctions in 2025 against 6 banks, a finance company, a payment institution and a microfinance body, withdrawing the licence of one payment institution, as reported with its 22nd annual supervision report.
title: Bank Al-Maghrib : 15 sanctions prononcées en 2025 dont 2 retraits d'agrément
